rule: Each plan case of the group, in plan order. A W04_OFFLINE case lists its properties (the obligation's and acceptance row's parts) with the tests that show each one in this run; it is PASS only when every property is PASS, and a property that needs an environment this run lacks is NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE and names the plan cases that carry it. A case that waits for W05's release set or for W06's native hosts is NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never PASS (AGENTS rule 14), and its catalog names the contract vectors whose own outputs and final snapshots are its expected results.
